tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: Assets this endpoint can simulate, with the date each series starts and ends. Call before composing a plan so start dates fall inside coverage.

tools.name: data_status
tools.description: The vintage of the loaded price data and how often it refreshes.

tools.name: run_dca
tools.description: Simulate one dollar-cost-averaging plan against real historical closes. Returns totals, end-of-year checkpoints and a share_url that opens the same run in the app.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Run up to 5 plans over the same data and rank them by final value (2 without a signed-in Pro account or a Pro API key). Use to compare assets, cadences or start dates side by side. One share_url opens them all together.
